findings.message: Rule-bearing legacy code in Clinic.Rules.visitFee matches no observation and cites no authority: 'match' branch (line 20); case pattern "k1" (line 21); decimal literal 60.00 (line 21); wildcard default returning 0m for unlisted cases (line 22). Value 60.00 equals DEC-C09.visit-fees.k1 (accepted). A wildcard default silently decides every unlisted case; no record authorizes that default. Question for Finance: which accepted record, if any, authorizes it? New work must not reuse it until answered; the legacy code is left unchanged.
